integrity: An exact 32-state recurrence with a finite five-step equality proves the all-length theorem; the packaged standard-library checker replays the finite certificate and independent full-word enumeration. No independent external validation has been carried out.
limitations: Exactly one nonwrapping cyclic rotation of a window of four bits; not general substring permutations, windows of length at most four, or multiple errors.
No classification of all maximizing centers and no claim about exact optimal code cardinality.
Unindexed equivalent earlier investigations cannot be ruled out.
title: Sharp maximum size of a binary four-symbol cyclic-rotation error ball
